I couldn't add the `--org` option to `clever addon providers show`: all three edits to `src/commands/addon/addon.providers.show.command.js` were denied because write permission wasn't granted. Nothing has changed in the repo, and I haven't run `npm run docs` or `npm run validate`.

Here is the change I tried to make, all in that one file:
- **Imports:** add `getOwnerIdFromOrgIdOrName` from `../../models/ids-resolver.js`, and `orgaIdOrNameOption` from `../global.options.js`.
- **Options:** add `org: orgaIdOrNameOption` next to `format`.
- **Handler:** when `--org` is given, resolve it to an owner ID and pass that ID to `Addon.getProvider(providerName, ownerId)`. `getProvider` already accepts an `orgaId`, so the model needs no change. Without `--org` the call stays as it is today.

`addon create` uses the same option and resolver.

If you grant write access, I'll apply the edits, then run `npm run docs` and `npm run validate`. `docs` regenerates `addon.docs.md`, which needs network.
